summary: Central Puerto S.A., an Argentine electric services issuer, filed a Form 6-K to report an open-market repurchase of its own book-entry common shares under Argentina's Capital Markets Law and CNV rules. On September 4, 2026, the company bought 60,000 shares on the BYMA exchange at an average price of ARS 2,224.69 per share, totaling ARS 133,481,662, settling September 7, 2026. Purchases were capped at 25% of 90-day average daily volume, per regulatory limits. This is a routine share buyback disclosure, not a tender offer.
